thread:
Asha: Heads-up: Cobalt's Flutter integration is spiking 401s then 429s during onboarding. They report preflight/webhook fanout right after app launch. Attached snippet from their device logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:02:12 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "invalid_token" }
```
Also later:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 300
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```
They're on ephemeral keys + client-side preflight that hits our SDK gateway with ~20 concurrent preflights on cold start. Can someone triage?

Jordan: Thanks — can you confirm whether the flutter SDK is sending `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `authorization: Token <token>`? We had a case where Android http client lowercased header and our proxy rules were strict.

Asha: Good call. Customer says their code uses `authorization: Token ...` (lowercase) via their plugin. They also show 401 TTLs that map to token refresh attempts.

Miguel: EdgeProxyBot flagged a short window of 401->retry storm and then 429s. Likely pattern: client tries refresh -> many concurrent auth attempts -> gateway enforces rate limit. We rate-limit by key+ip by default.

EdgeProxyBot: Alert: 1769999998 - spike detected - 401 rate 18/s -> fallback 429s observed. Bucket exhausted for key fk_live_cobalt_01.

Jordan: Two quick repro/mitigation asks:
1) Can Cobalt switch header to `Authorization: Bearer ...` (case-sensitive) or use our SDK helper `setAuthBearer()`?
2) Add initial jittered backoff for token refresh so not all instances refresh at once.

Asha: I pinged the Cobalt eng lead and they said adding `Bearer` is low-friction. They prefer a fix on our side too — worried about other customers using different flutter http libs.

Miguel: Short-term mitigation we can recommend to them: reduce preflight concurrency to 3 and enable exponential backoff (base=200ms, max=5s). Long-term: we should make the gateway accept `authorization: token` in addition to `Authorization: Bearer` for compat. I'll open a secure patch.

Jordan: I can draft a small patch for the SDK to normalize the header casing/value on send (lower/upper + prefix). Also will add a note in Flutter quickstart about token header formats.

Asha: Can we have an emergency enablement call with Cobalt in 30m? They want to validate fixes live. I'll host.

Miguel: I'll prepare a temporary token-scope bump and whitelist their key for a 10-min window to avoid rate cuts during the call. Will also tail gateway logs.

Jordan: Patch plan:
- short-term SDK change: normalize `authorization` headers and always send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- docs update + quickstart snippet
- long-term gateway fix: accept common auth header patterns

Asha: Sending the meeting invite now. Customer wants confirmation steps to run after we push the SDK tweak:
1) redeploy app with SDK dev build
2) confirm `Authorization: Bearer` in outgoing request (show curl sample)
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/ping
```
3) watch `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header and confirm no 401s for 5 min

Miguel: I'll also add a temporary telemetry tag for `cobalt_onboard_1769` so we can filter spikes.

Asha: Thanks team. After call we'll capture notes and add a CS playbook entry for Flutter preflight patterns (concurrency/backoff + header normalization). I'll post the playbook draft here after the enablement session. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Noted. If anyone needs the SDK branch link I can push to `devex/flutter-auth-normalize` and tag you.

Asha: Please do. Closing the loop post-call with recording + next steps.

EdgeProxyBot: Incident note appended to thread: cobalt_onboard_1769 - mitigation window set 10m.
